decisions.reason: Report reconstructs the full corridor (present at/before rc.2, removed in alpha.1 per A1-02 symptoms, restored in alpha.2 as revert) in a corridor table, applies the net state to produceExternalEvent in fixture/src/events.ts, and gives equivalent history beyond bare card names, grounded in the fixture file.
